verdict: Approved for the assigned pages 220–225 (images 228–233). Nothing is clipped. Hebrew and English columns don't overlap, and both stay inside the margins. The running heads and page numbers alternate correctly between recto and verso. Hebrew vowel points, dagesh/mappiq (e.g. וְנִלְוָה, יְהוֹה, עַמְּךָ), maqaf and sof-pasuq render cleanly and are readable at page size. I saw no stray CGJ boxes or detached marks. The ↗ markers appear consistently in both Hebrew and English (e.g. ↗אָנוּסָה / ↗I hasten; ↗כַּכָּתוּב עַל יַד נְבִיאֶךָ / ↗As it is written through Thy prophet). The חזן and קהל rubrics are bold and correctly placed. Stanza rows are paired and top-aligned throughout. The section break before 'אִם שַׁבָּת / On Sabbath.' (rule, then bold heading, then the HE-only note 'מיוסד ע"ס א"ב כפול בראשי החרוזות') matches the intended stylesheet. There are no footnotes on these pages, so note order and placement didn't come up. Approval covers only these six pages. The priestly-blessing endpoint, the missing-source label and the sources/credits are outside the assigned images and still need checking separately.
